reason: The Tagging API Welcome page says GetResources, GetTagKeys and GetTagValues support all resource types; the GetResources page says it returns all tagged or previously tagged resources in the specified Region for the account; the KMS tagging page says customer managed keys can be tagged at creation and existing keys tagged or untagged unless pending deletion. The inference that a tagged customer managed key falls under 'all resource types' follows literally, and the claim makes no statement about listing keys in PendingDeletion, as its condition notes.
